note: P13 (D-FW scenario vectors; Summary Section 9 rows D1, D2, D4; Design Rev 3.45 Section 11.2). Times are now_ms on a single monotonic firmware clock starting at t0=0 for each scenario unless an action sets a new base. events are consumed in order by step(state, event, now_ms) for the state machine the scenario names: man_down (fall suspicion, check-in, latch, MAYDAY), scba (declared mode, confirm/response timers, prompt), or both (deferral/priority cases touch man_down and scba together; MAYDAY-while-latched touches man_down only). event kinds: IMPACT (peak accel >= IMPACT_G), STILL (chest RMS below STILL_G), MOTION (chest RMS at/above STILL_G), CANCEL_JACKET, CANCEL_WRIST (clean 40-2000 ms press/release only; this file carries no bounce/stuck-button cases), SCBA_ON, SCBA_OFF, TICK (fsm_task 10 Hz re-evaluation, no edge of its own), BOOT (reset with a given persisted latch/cause). bit references use shared/abi.json: flags.mandown (bit 2), flags.checkin (bit 7), status3.scba_expired (bit 3), status4.mayday (bit 4). Constants referenced (shared/constants.json): fall_checkin_timeout_s=10, checkin_still_s=15, mayday_presses=3, mayday_window_s=2, scba_confirm_s=300, scba_confirm_high_co_s=120, scba_response_s=20. This file is scenario-level only; it does not replace frames.json (wire bytes) or the golden vectors (host rule engine).

scenarios.desc: CANCEL with a motionless chest during a check-in: the press stays pending for 10 s, is then rejected and the prompt re-issued, while the stillness and check-in timers keep running and the stillness timer is not reset (cancel_no_motion)

events.note: 15 s stillness reached: check-in prompt issued (flags.checkin bit set, level WARNING, no latch yet)
clean press while chest stays below STILL_G; motion test starts, pending up to 10 s
10 s after the press with no MOTION event: press rejected, logged cancel_no_motion, prompt re-issued
stillness timer was never reset by the rejected press, so it keeps counting from t=0

scenarios.desc: a fall-started check-in is not auto-cleared by 3 s of motion: IMPACT starts CHECK-IN, then MOTION briefly at 3 s does not itself clear the prompt (only a clean CANCEL answers it, and only if chest RMS then rises above STILL_G within the CANCEL's own 10 s motion test)

events.note: horizontal posture or chest motion below STILL_G within 3 s of IMPACT: CHECK-IN starts, display 'uncertain' not yet resolved
3 s of motion after the check-in prompt, with no CANCEL pressed
15 s of (net) stillness after the prompt with no answering CANCEL: unanswered check-in still running toward its own latch path, never auto-cleared by the unprompted 3 s motion alone

scenarios.desc: three clean jacket CANCEL presses within 2 s give MAYDAY, evaluated on the third press

events.note: three clean presses, all within mayday_window_s=2 s of Press 1, clear_armed==0: promoted to MAYDAY on this press

scenarios.desc: MAYDAY fires retroactively: Press 1 immediately answers and clears an active SCBA prompt, then Press 2 and Press 3 arrive within 2 s of Press 1 and the burst is promoted to MAYDAY after the fact

events.note: an SCBA confirmation prompt is already open when this scenario starts
Press 1: clean press, answers and clears the open SCBA prompt immediately
Press 2
Press 3, within 2 s of Press 1: burst promoted retroactively to MAYDAY, clear_armed was 0 throughout

scenarios.desc: MAYDAY fires retroactively when Press 1 was rejected by the CANCEL-without-motion rule (still pending its own 10 s motion check) and Press 2 and Press 3 then land within 2 s of Press 1

events.note: check-in prompt open
Press 1: pending its own 10 s motion test, not yet accepted or rejected
Press 2, within 2 s of Press 1
Press 3, within 2 s of Press 1: three clean presses in <=2 s, clear_armed==0, so MAYDAY is promoted even though Press 1 is still mid motion-check and not itself exempt from that rule

scenarios.desc: MAYDAY while man-down is already latched upgrades the stored cause and sets status4 bit 4, sent as a new critical frame

events.note: 15 s unanswered check-in latches man-down DANGER, cause man_down, status4 mayday bit 0
three clean presses within 2 s while already latched: not blocked by clear_armed since no clear sequence is armed

scenarios.desc: a check-in prompt deferred by an SCBA-ON state keeps the SCBA confirmation clock running; the check-in prompt suspends the SCBA prompt UI (priority: check-in/degraded over SCBA) and resumes it on expiry or cancel

events.note: 280 s of SCBA ON with no 35+ ppm CO frame: ordinary scba_confirm_s=300 clock, no prompt yet
300 s reached: SCBA confirmation prompt opens
a fall suspicion fires while the SCBA prompt is open: check-in takes the buzzer/CANCEL slot, SCBA prompt UI is suspended but its own expiry clock keeps running
10 s after the IMPACT, within fall_checkin_timeout_s: check-in still pending, SCBA prompt UI still suspended
15 s of stillness since the IMPACT with no CANCEL: check-in unanswered, moving toward man-down latch
about scba_response_s=20 s after the 300 s mark (plus the up-to-~15 s deferral the design allows), the SCBA prompt's own clock expires while its UI was suspended

scenarios.desc: an IMU-degraded prompt defers an open SCBA prompt the same way a check-in prompt does (priority: check-in/IMU-degraded over SCBA confirmation)

events.note: 5 s IMU-fault grace elapsed: degraded prompt fires immediately, suspending the SCBA prompt UI while its expiry clock keeps running
SCBA prompt's own clock expires with no clean CANCEL answering it (deferral at the ~15 s ceiling the design names)

scenarios.desc: scba_expired is set with no prompt ever shown during a latched man-down or MAYDAY, because the check-in/degraded prompt that would occupy the buzzer/CANCEL slot at priority never fires once the node is already latched, and the SCBA expiry clock still runs

events.note: man-down latches DANGER

scba_confirm_s=300 plus scba_response_s=20 elapsed since SCBA_ON, entirely while latched; no SCBA prompt UI was ever shown because the node is already in man-down, not in a normal unlatched check-in/degraded cycle

scenarios.desc: an SCBA prompt deferred by a check-in that is itself answered (clean CANCEL with motion within 10 s) resumes the suspended SCBA prompt UI rather than clearing scba_expired

events.note: clean press answering the check-in
chest RMS rises above STILL_G within 10 s of the press: check-in accepted, cancel_ack broadcast
check-in cleared, SCBA prompt UI resumes with its clock already having run since t=300000
